comparison.scope: Matched single-seed attempted-shot budgets at inherited 25/5/5 coordinates, not an isolated PPO ablation. Geometry assists held-out contexts. Controller/precompute/native elapsed costs differ. Nominal repeats are not independent noise/layout robustness trials.

deterministic_mean_action_change.scope: Direct deterministic network outputs before IK; changes alone do not prove a capture-rate improvement

home_comparison.scope: Canonical simulator episode reset before visible drives. Measured home state repeatability and target consistency are reported separately; retained path flags describe reset eligibility, not a physical home trajectory. No score rows are removed and no physical calibration/collision certificate is implied.
